product_overview: Split Fun PRO is a Cloudflare Workers-based backend for managing shared expenses, groups, settlements and gamified payment reminders. It provides authentication, group and expense management, reminders (Don Barriga), and achievements to motivate timely payments.
core_goals: Provide secure email/password authentication with email verification and password recovery
Enable users to create and manage groups, register shared expenses, and compute simplified debt balances
Offer friendly, gamified payment reminders (memes stored in R2) and an achievements system to boost engagement
Support invited, unregistered members (via email) and friend-code based user discovery
Keep sessions persistent (60 days), protect user data (email encryption, strong password hashing), and run entirely on Cloudflare infrastructure

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register, verify email, login/logout and reset password using one-time tokens; sessions use an HTTP-only cookie (60 days).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with body {email, password} -> Receive 200 {success: true, message: string} (verification email sent)
POST /api/auth/verify-email with body {token: "<verification_token>"} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
POST /api/auth/login with body {email, password} -> Receive 200 {success: true} and set HTTP-only session cookie
POST /api/auth/logout with session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: POST /api/auth/register with invalid email or weak password -> Receive 400 {error: INVALID_EMAIL|WEAK_PASSWORD, message: string}
ERROR: POST /api/auth/login with wrong credentials -> Receive 401 {error: INVALID_CREDENTIALS, message: string}
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with body {email} -> Receive 200 {success: true, message: string} (response does not reveal whether email exists)
POST /api/auth/reset-password with body {token: "<reset_token>", password: "newPass"} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: POST /api/auth/reset-password with expired/invalid token -> Receive 400 {error: string, message: string}
ERROR: POST /api/auth/logout without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}

features.name: User Profile & Search
features.description: View and update the authenticated user's profile (display name, friend code) and search for users by friend code.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with body {email, password} -> Receive 200 and set session cookie -> GET /api/users/me with session cookie -> Receive 200 {id: string, email: string}
GET /api/profile with session cookie -> Receive 200 {display_name: string, friend_code: string}
PATCH /api/profile with session cookie and body {display_name: "New Name"} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: GET /api/users/me without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}
GET /api/users/search?q=abc with session cookie (q >= 3 chars) -> Receive 200 {results: [{id, display_name, friend_code}]}
ERROR: GET /api/users/search?q=ab with session cookie (q < 3 chars) -> Receive 400 {error: string}

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Aggregated view of groups, recent expenses and consolidated owed/owing totals; consolidated debts across groups.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 200 {groups: Group[], recentExpenses: Expense[], totalOwed: number, totalOwing: number}
GET /api/my-debts with session cookie -> Receive 200 {debts: [{groupId, groupName, from, to, amount}]}
ERROR: GET /api/dashboard without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}

features.name: Groups
features.description: Create, list, view, update and delete expense-sharing groups; fetch simplified balances for a group.
user_flows: POST /api/groups with session cookie and body {name, emoji, description} -> Receive 200 Group
GET /api/groups with session cookie -> Receive 200 Group[]
GET /api/groups/:id with session cookie -> Receive 200 Group (members, expenses, settlements)
PATCH /api/groups/:id with session cookie and body {name, emoji, description} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
DELETE /api/groups/:id with session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
GET /api/groups/:id/balances with session cookie -> Receive 200 {balances: [{from, to, amount}]}
ERROR: GET /api/groups/:id with session cookie by non-member -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}
ERROR: GET /api/groups/:id with session cookie for non-existent id -> Receive 404 {error: Not Found}
ERROR: DELETE /api/groups/:id by non-member -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}

features.name: Group Members
features.description: Add or remove members from a group, by friend code or by email (supports inviting unregistered users).
user_flows: POST /api/groups/:id/members with session cookie and body {friend_code: "ABC123"} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
POST /api/groups/:id/members with session cookie and body {email: "invitee@example.com", display_name: "Pat"} -> Receive 200 {success: true} (invites unregistered member)
DELETE /api/groups/:id/members/:memberId with session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: POST /api/groups/:id/members with invalid friend_code -> Receive 404 {error: User Not Found}
ERROR: POST /api/groups/:id/members with malformed body -> Receive 400 {error: string}
ERROR: DELETE /api/groups/:id/members/:memberId by unauthorized user -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Create, list and delete expenses within groups; support equal or percentage-based splits and cascade deletes for splits.
user_flows: POST /api/expenses with session cookie and body {group_id, description, amount, paid_by, date, splits: [{member_id, amount}]} -> Receive 200 Expense
GET /api/expenses with session cookie -> Receive 200 Expense[]
GET /api/groups/:id/expenses with session cookie -> Receive 200 Expense[]
DELETE /api/expenses/:id with session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: POST /api/expenses with splits that do not sum to amount -> Receive 400 {error: string}
ERROR: DELETE /api/expenses/:id by non-member -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}
ERROR: GET /api/groups/:id/expenses for non-existent group -> Receive 404 {error: Not Found}

features.name: Settlements
features.description: Record payments between members and view settlement history for a group.
user_flows: POST /api/settlements with session cookie and body {group_id, from_member_id, to_member_id, amount, note} -> Receive 200 {success: true, id: string}
GET /api/groups/:id/settlements with session cookie -> Receive 200 Settlement[]
ERROR: POST /api/settlements with amount greater than outstanding debt -> Receive 400 {error: string}
ERROR: GET /api/groups/:id/settlements without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}

features.name: Payment Reminders (Don Barriga)
features.description: Send gamified payment reminders with meme assets in R2, list reminders, count unseen reminders and mark reminders as seen.
user_flows: POST /api/payment-reminders with session cookie and body {to_member_id, group_id, message, meme_key} -> Receive 200 {success: true, id: string}
GET /api/payment-reminders with session cookie -> Receive 200 PaymentReminder[]
GET /api/payment-reminders/count with session cookie -> Receive 200 {count: number}
PATCH /api/payment-reminders/:id/seen with session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
ERROR: POST /api/payment-reminders with invalid meme_key -> Receive 400 {error: string}
ERROR: PATCH /api/payment-reminders/:id/seen for non-existent id -> Receive 404 {error: Not Found}

features.name: Achievements
features.description: Track user milestones and unlock badges when users perform qualifying actions (create group, register settlement, etc.).
user_flows: GET /api/achievements with session cookie -> Receive 200 {achievements: [{key: string, unlocked_at: string}]}
POST /api/achievements/check with session cookie -> Receive 200 {newly_unlocked: string[]}
ERROR: GET /api/achievements without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}
